scripts.build:assets: cd "$INIT_CWD" && sass assets/css/application.scss public/assets/css/application.css --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=import && esbuild assets/js/main.js --bundle --outdir=public/assets/js
scripts.watch:assets: cd "$INIT_CWD" && (sass assets/css/application.scss public/assets/css/application.css --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=import --watch & esbuild assets/js/main.js --bundle --outdir=public/assets/js --watch=forever & wait)
